text:
Maya Nguyen: Heads-up — HelixCare onboarding call tomorrow. They've got a list of UX + billing asks. Can we capture snippets into buckets so Product can triage quickly?
Jamal Ortiz: I pulled the call notes. Top items: per-route billing confusion, stale embeddings causing poor search, dashboard timeout errors.
Otis Lane: Paste the raw quotes and I'll format for import into the feedback tracker.
Maya Nguyen: Copying raw snippets below — please bucket by theme and add severity tag. If we hit >3 blockers call it a renewal risk. @Priya Shah FYI.
```
"We can't reconcile cost per route — numbers don't match our invoices." — Jaime (billing manager)
"Embeddings are stale; search misses our latest product SKU updates." — Rachel (catalog lead)
"Dashboard times out when we try to pull 90-day usage." — Sam (ops)
"Need a per-environment toggle for embeddings refresh cadence." — Jaime
```
Priya Shah: Thanks — quick Q: what's HelixCare's size / ARR? That changes prioritization.
Jamal Ortiz: Mid-market, ~45k ARR contract, onboarding stalled ~3 weeks, NPS slipping. Jaime called out renewal concern if we can't fix billing clarity.
Maya Nguyen: :warning: Renewal risk: medium-high. Recommendation: short-term workaround (per-route billing toggle in UI) + long-term reconciliation UI.
Otis Lane: I created a CSV schema for import. Fields: customer, user_quote, theme, severity, impact_notes, suggested_owner. Jamal can you map these?
Jamal Ortiz: Yep. I'll export a CSV and drop in #cs-uploads. Sample rows below:
```csv
customer,user_quote,theme,severity,impact_notes,suggested_owner
HelixCare,"We can't reconcile cost per route",billing,high,"Finance can't forecast","Product: billingUX"
HelixCare,"Embeddings are stale; search misses",embeddings,medium,"Search relevance down 20%","ML infra"
HelixCare,"Dashboard times out on 90-day pull",performance,low,"Happens during heavy hours","Eng infra"
```
Priya Shah: Perfect. If we can get top 3 themes + severity + an owner by EOD, I'll slot a lightweight ask into next week's roadmap sync.
Maya Nguyen: Plan: Jamal finishes CSV, Otis preps a one-pager for the workaround, Priya evaluates priority for roadmap. I'll notify CSMs to surface any other blockers.
Otis Lane: I'll own the workaround PR and validate the toggle UX.
Jamal Ortiz: CSV uploaded to #cs-uploads: https://redwood-slack.fake/cs-uploads/helixcare-cs-snippets.csv :paperclip:
Priya Shah: Reviewing now. Will comment with ask + impact estimate by 17:30.
Maya Nguyen: Thanks team — this is the format I want for all mid-market onboarding gaps. Quick capture, one owner, and a short mitigation. :thumbsup:
feedback-bot: Ticket created: PROD-FB-5678 (HelixCare onboarding bucketed)
Otis Lane: noted, will follow up on the PR tomorrow morning.
Jamal Ortiz: Ping me if you need any clarification from Jaime — I'll schedule a 15-min follow-up.
Priya Shah: Got it. EOD deliverables noted.
Maya Nguyen: Closing the thread — will post status in the renewal tracker after roadmap sync.
